description: Dual-run: primary compute produces the canonical value (production unchanged); a shadow compute runs after primary and its output is diffed against primary. Emits AssetObservation per run with shadow_match=true|false + diff metadata (mode, diff_rows, extra/missing cols, error). Classic migration playbook — ship shadow, verify convergence, flip primary, drop shadow. Shadow exceptions trapped by default; enforce_match=true raises dg.Failure on mismatch. Companion @shadow decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Materialization = primary result; AssetObservation captures shadow verdict + diff metadata.

enforce_match.label: Enforce Match
enforce_match.description: false (default) observes; true raises dg.Failure on mismatch.

name: Shadow Asset
